reviews.text: i had to take off 1 start because of the AI bot i have to talk to when i call the clinic. i’d prefer to talk to a person when discussing things about my dog. there’s only so much an AI bot can do for me. all of the misunderstandings can be really frustrating, especially for clients that are older. having a real person to person conversation is 100% times better.

Pathetic doctor and service. $95 for an exam fee and she didn’t even have the courtesy to send me the soap notes when I requested it multiple times, just am diagnosed my cat with cancer and left her to be. No other doctor takes a serious diagnosis like this so lightly and esp considering the high exam fee. All they care about is money not the animals. Will not recommend this place to anyone its expensive and if you’re expensive the least you can do is actually provide good care and customer service. I’ve got no response to my multiple emails about getting the soap notes or just anything even an after visit summary form the doctor! Please don’t call yourself a doctor if you can’t take the responsibility to act like one.

Thank you for taking such good care of my boy Andy this morning. Phenomenal service!
Michael B

Paid $100 for the vet to diagnose the stray dog I found that had been hit by a car or attacked as “feeling ouchy” and quoted me an additional $1000 for wound care and X-rays. Vet was very rude but the rest of the staff was lovely.
Very caring and understanding when dealing with a a very sad situation with my pet. My go to vet since I moved to the area and every time they have been understanding and helpful with advice and care
Service is okay, but the price is over the roof compared to the other clinic we go to.
They made sure my dog was well without surgery.
Professional, caring and knowledgeable. You get what you pay for with vets.

I want to make this review very clear, this is a practice my family has been going to for over 20 years, and this is not against Crossroads Animal Clinic. The techs have always been amazing, My family misses the doctors who retired that helped our family pets for so many years,but we are happy they get to enjoy this stage of life.

THIS REVIEW IS STRICTLY FOR DR. MUNDO. She is overall rude, and dismissive of her patients. I brought my cat in for treatment for a depro medrol shot which I have discussed many times with many vets that I understand the risks of a steroidal injection but unfortunately it’s the only thing we could find that works for her. Dr. Mundo had come in and said “yeah, im not doing depro” no conversation, no explaination, nothing.

I explained everything and she just made a face like I was an idiot and said she was giving her a pill, I explained I was willing to try it but I doubt it would work. The pills did not work.

I called back later after she had another issue with the mystery allergy, but I was insistent I didn’t want to see Dr. Mundo after how I was treated last visit.

DR. SHELBY WAS AMAZING and helped us greatly with my cats treatment, he was patient and listened to what I had to say about the allergy issues my cat has been having. He offered to do the depro shot as long as we got her bloodwork done, which of course came back perfect health.

I explained to Dr. Shelby that we would likely need to do another within 30 days because she’s been off the depro for so long, and that typically the shots need more frequency during summer, and in winter and fall it’s less frequent. He said he understands and that I just need to call when needed.

The other day (7/31/25)I called to make a tech appointment for a depro shot, and Dr. Mundo sticks her nose in something that is not her business as I made it clear for the second time when I made the appointment that I don’t work with Dr. Mundo, and instructs the tech to cancel the appointment.

I had already made it extremely clear that I do not want to work with Dr. Mundo prior in several conversations.

Moral of the story/ TLDR: Dr. Mundo is stuck up, does not care what the pet parents think, and is rude and dismissive, bad practice. Do not give her business. Dr. Shelby did amazing and will be working with him in the future.
Nice and clean clinic for your pets.
We have been going to Crossroads for years. Great staff and Dr Mundo is amazing. They are very accommodating to both our dogs. Couldn't be happier with the attention everyone gives.

The good doctors retired. Had an emergency with my dogs ear and the vet literally said to her face she did not have time to help us. And this is supposed to be a animal hospital. There excuse was the other doctors had retired. So why wouldn't your hire more doctors if you knew multiple people were retiring. We went to vca off Telge where they were most helpful. Will be taking our other animals there from now on.

Update for their comment. He did not need sedation vca clean the wound and gave him antibiotics and pain meds. All without sedation. And he is doing better now thanks to you who literally said we don't have time for you. Moral of the story don't take your dogs here.

I've taken my pets to Crossroads for the last twenty years.  They are always friendly and professional.  The staff is fantastic, they are very good with dogs and cats alike.  They diagnosed my dog with epilepsy and helped us understand the condition and provided an effective treatment plan.
These people are truly compassionate.  I highly recommend them for your pets!
The staff at crossroads are great the took great care of my cat's especially my siamese who had tumors
Very nice ladies in the front office.
Always ready to help our babies.
